chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ, who said:
I asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام about a man who has intercourse with a woman short of the private part, and the woman emits fluid. Is ghusl obligatory upon her? He said: “Yes.”

key_terms.الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam al-Riḍā, peace be upon him
key_terms.غُسْلٌ: ritual bath required after a state of janabah

ai.seo_question: Does a woman have to perform ghusl if she emits fluid during intimacy without vaginal intercourse?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning janabah and ritual purity. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام states that if the woman emits fluid in such a case, ghusl is obligatory upon her.
